## 🧑‍💻 About Me

- 🔭 Currently building **ActionMind AI** — a live meeting intelligence platform that turns conversations into tracked, assigned, auto-followed-up tasks.
- 🧠 Deep in **Claude Code** and the **Model Context Protocol** — I build custom MCP servers that give models real, governed access to business tools.
- 🤖 I specialise in **agentic automation**: taking a repetitive human workflow and replacing it with a reliable, observable AI pipeline.
- 🌐 Full-stack by trade — **React + Vite** front-ends, **FastAPI / Node + Express** back-ends, **Supabase / MongoDB** data layers.
- ☁️ Ship-focused: **AWS** deployments and CI/CD via **GitHub Actions**, with monitoring baked in from day one.
- 💬 Ask me about **MCP server design, Claude-powered agents, real-time WebSocket systems, or React + FastAPI architecture**.
- 📫 Reach me at **[panhwerzohaib2@gmail.com](https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=panhwerzohaib2@gmail.com)** — always open to collaboration and new opportunities.

### 🧠 [ActionMind AI](https://github.com/Zohaib-Aziz-Panhwar/ActionMind_AI)

Live meeting intelligence that converts conversations into tasks — summaries, owners, deadlines, and missing-decision detection, in real time.

**Highlights**
- Real-time transcription → reasoning pipeline over **WebSockets**
- **MCP servers** for Gmail, Google Calendar &amp; Notion
- Auto-drafts follow-up emails &amp; calendar invites (`.ics`)
- **Clerk** auth · **MongoDB** persistence

`Node.js` · `Express` · `LLM Agents` · `MCP` · `MongoDB`

### 💼 [Personal Portfolio Website](https://github.com/Zohaib-Aziz-Panhwar/Personal-Portfolio-Website)

A modern, responsive full-stack portfolio with a decoupled API backend and a transactional contact service.

**Highlights**
- **React 18 + Vite** SPA with React Router
- **FastAPI** backend (Pydantic models, async email)
- Data fetching via **TanStack Query** + Axios
